<thought>Analyzing the observed isotopic pattern: the series of peaks spaced ~1 Da apart with relative intensities roughly following a binomial distribution (M+1 ≈ 12.5 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1 % of M, rapidly decreasing thereafter) matches the natural ¹³C/¹²C isotopic distribution for a molecule containing about 12 carbon atoms. No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this shape and spacing at these intensities (e.g., Cl, Br, S would give different relative intensities). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
